checks.name: Lift motor shoe strip bending
checks.method: Simply supported central point load: 6(FL/4)/(bt^2). No torque credited.
checks.unresolved: Motor bolt pattern, local plate action, fatigue and clamp preload absent; 69.2 N thrust is hypothetical.

checks.name: Arm saddle average bond shear
checks.method: Maximum absolute support reaction / effective bond area.
checks.unresolved: Reversed support reactions require tension-capable connection; peel, core pullout, rib buckling and vibration open.

checks.name: Wing root cap axial stress
checks.method: N=M/h, sigma=N/(bt); entire bending moment on one cap pair.
checks.unresolved: Actual effective width, minimum separation, compression buckling and center-box connection not substantiated.

checks.name: Wing root transfer bond shear
checks.unresolved: Nonuniform end shear and peel omitted; actual spar/cap/rib load sharing unknown.

checks.name: Battery retention per strap
checks.method: Pack mass * assumed 6g retention envelope * 1.5, equally shared by two straps.
checks.unresolved: 6g is a proposed requirement, not agreed landing/crash envelope. Each strap should independently retain full load if redundancy is required; latch rating unknown.

checks.name: Tail root couple force
checks.method: Tail panel moment / proposed effective root depth.
checks.unresolved: Tail attachment peel, laminate crippling, skin-shell transfer and asymmetric control loads unresolved.

checks.name: Pusher axial demand
checks.unresolved: Maximum/static thrust, motor torque, gyroscopic and lateral inertia cases missing; not a governing verified design load.
